# UblEx v0.8.5 - Table of Contents

> UBL (Universal Business Language) document generation and parsing for Elixir.
Supports Peppol BIS Billing 3.0 compliant invoices, credit notes, and application responses with SBDH support.

## Pages

- [UblEx](https://ubl-ex.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [Changelog](https://ubl-ex.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)
- [LICENSE](https://ubl-ex.hexdocs.pm/license.md)

## Modules

- [UblEx](https://ubl-ex.hexdocs.pm/UblEx.md): UBL (Universal Business Language) document generation and parsing for Elixir.
- [UblEx.Validator](https://ubl-ex.hexdocs.pm/UblEx.Validator.md): Validates UBL documents against Peppol BIS Billing 3.0 rules using the
peppol.helger.com validation web service.

- Generators
  - [UblEx.Generator.ApplicationResponse](https://ubl-ex.hexdocs.pm/UblEx.Generator.ApplicationResponse.md): Generator for Peppol BIS Billing 3.0 compliant ApplicationResponse (message acknowledgment) documents.
  - [UblEx.Generator.CreditNote](https://ubl-ex.hexdocs.pm/UblEx.Generator.CreditNote.md): Generate Peppol-compliant UBL CreditNote XML documents.

  - [UblEx.Generator.Helpers](https://ubl-ex.hexdocs.pm/UblEx.Generator.Helpers.md): Helper functions for UBL generation.
  - [UblEx.Generator.Invoice](https://ubl-ex.hexdocs.pm/UblEx.Generator.Invoice.md): Generate Peppol-compliant UBL Invoice XML documents.

  - [UblEx.Generator.SBDH](https://ubl-ex.hexdocs.pm/UblEx.Generator.SBDH.md): Generate Standard Business Document Header (SBDH) wrappers for UBL documents.

- Parsers
  - [UblEx.Parser.SimpleParser](https://ubl-ex.hexdocs.pm/UblEx.Parser.SimpleParser.md): Simple direct parser using Saxy to parse UBL XML into maps.
No XPath, no intermediate DOM - just straightforward event handling.

  - [UblEx.Parser.UblHandler](https://ubl-ex.hexdocs.pm/UblEx.Parser.UblHandler.md): Direct Saxy handler for parsing UBL documents into our target map format.
Knows the UBL structure and builds the result directly without XPath.
